Joint Venture Between ACE & KATO
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:RelatedPartyTransactionExplana: During the current quarter ended 30 September 2026, pursuant to the Investment and Shareholders' Agreement dated 11 March 2026 entered into between the Company and Kato Works Co., Ltd., Japan ("KATO"), the Company completed the transfer of its Heavy Cranes business undertaking to ACE KATO Private Limited ("ACE KATO") on a slump sale basis as a going concern. Upon completion of the transfer, the Company and KATO each hold 50% interest in ACE KATO. As ACE KATO is dependent on the Company and KATO for their continous operations and its ability to generate cash flows to settle its obligations, ACE KATO is classified as a joint operation as per Ind AS 111. In accordance with Ind AS 111, the Company has accounted for its interest in ACE KATO in its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results. Pursuant to the slump sale, as mentioned above, the Company has transferred net assets having a carrying value of INR 1,970 lakhs and in return received equity shares of ACE KATO having fair value of INR 11,970 lakhs, resulting into a gain of INR 5,000 lakhs (representing the gains only to the extent of the other parties' interests in the joint operation) which has been disclosed under Exceptional items in the unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results
